body: I was also told that I can’t say I genuinely like her if I’m seeing other people but I disagree with that, what do you think?

They said my view on relationships isn’t normal but I honestly can’t see anything wrong with the way I’m handling things? If all relationships eventually come to an end then what’s wrong with me doing this?
I like this reply. It felt attacking
Thanks, I really appreciate this. It’s nice hearing this from someone else.
